requirement: The system shall prevent any stock movement that would take a bin's on-hand quantity below zero.
The system shall compute the stock value of each SKU as on-hand quantity multiplied by the current standard cost, and roll these up to a total inventory valuation.
The warehouse operator scans an inbound pallet; the system records the receipt, places the SKU in the suggested bin and updates the on-hand quantity.
The picker is shown a suggested pick path; the system orders the picks by bin aisle and position so that the picker walks the shortest route.
As a warehouse supervisor, I want to see the current stock level for a SKU across all bins so that I can decide whether to reorder.
As a stock controller, I want to record a stock count adjustment so that discrepancies from the physical count are reflected in the system.
A bin may not hold the same SKU in two temperature zones; a placement that would cause this must be rejected.
Every stock adjustment, receipt and pick must be recorded in a movement ledger with quantity, direction, user and timestamp.
The stock table shall ensure that a bin-SKU pair has a non-negative on-hand quantity and that its quantity does not exceed the bin's capacity.
code:
-- per-bin per-SKU stock table
CREATE TABLE bin_stock (
    bin_id       VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    sku          VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    on_hand      INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    reserved     INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at   TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT bin_stock_pk      PRIMARY KEY (bin_id, sku),
    CONSTRAINT bin_stock_bin_fk  FOREIGN KEY (bin_id) REFERENCES warehouse_bin(bin_id),
    CONSTRAINT bin_stock_sku_fk  FOREIGN KEY (sku) REFERENCES sku_master(sku),
    CONSTRAINT bin_stock_nonneg  CHECK (on_hand >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT bin_stock_reserve CHECK (reserved >= 0 AND reserved <= on_hand)
);

CREATE INDEX bin_stock_sku_idx ON bin_stock (sku);
hard_negatives:
-- warehouse bin master table
CREATE TABLE warehouse_bin (
    bin_id         VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY,
    aisle          VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    position       INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    zone           VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    capacity       INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT bin_zone_chk CHECK (zone IN ('AMBIENT','CHILLED','FROZEN','HAZMAT')),
    CONSTRAINT bin_capacity_positive CHECK (capacity > 0)
);
-- stock movement ledger
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
    movement_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    bin_id         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    sku            VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    signed_delta   INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    reason         VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    user_id        VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    occurred_at    TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT movement_nonzero CHECK (signed_delta <> 0)
);

requirement: Only users assigned to a warehouse may adjust stock in that warehouse; adjustments outside their assignment must be refused.
The replenishment job shall, for every SKU whose on-hand quantity is below its reorder point, create a purchase suggestion sized to bring stock back up to the target level.
